title: tunnelmind:crew_ops:v1 — Witness Event payloads
description: Binds each profile event_type to its payload schema. A conformant Witness Event MUST validate against BOTH the ATAP v0.1 base witness-event schema (the envelope: @context, id, hashes, signature) AND this schema (the event_type vocabulary and payload shape). Every payload sets additionalProperties:false — that is how this profile encodes the ATAP §7.6 no-PII prohibition: a payload carrying a person's name, email, IP address or any other person-resolvable field has no permitted key for it and fails validation. Every other field is a closed enum, a small integer, an agent id pattern or a sha256 digest, so no field can carry free text.

evidence.description: How strong the claim is. asserted: the agent says so. anchored: bound to something a verifier can look up (a DKIM-verified mail message id). witnessed: the witness observed it itself.

agent.description: A crew agent id (crew-<name>) or an agent role. No `@`, spaces or capitals, so it cannot carry a person's name or email.

evidence.description: The rails' own record of their decision.

class.description: Autonomy class of the action. Class 4 (pay, transfer, account, secret, credential, dns, delete, prose) is never grantable, so it has no event.

action.description: The action names the crew's rails decide on. Closed: a new action needs a new profile version.

target_sha256.description: sha256 of the action's target (path, branch or subject).

reason_sha256.description: sha256 of the rails' reason text, when there is one.

evidence.description: anchored only for a mail ratification carrying a DKIM-verified message id; otherwise asserted.

role.description: A human ratification records the role, never the person (ATAP §7.6).

text_sha256.description: sha256 of the ratification text; the text itself is a user communication and stays out of the payload.

dkim_message_id_sha256.description: sha256 of the Message-ID of the DKIM-verified ratification mail.

title_sha256.description: sha256 of the idea's title; the title is free text and stays out of the payload.

route.description: Where an acted-on idea goes; empty when it is parked or dropped.
